title: Autechre - Gantz Graf (Official Music Video) 1080p HD
summary: The official music video for Autechre's 'Gantz Graf', a dense, glitchy electronic track paired with abstract animated 3D visuals reportedly made by hand in 2002.
why: It comes up as an example of challenging, dense electronic music and as a hand-made visual-sync piece predating generative tools.

quote.text: I'd say Autechre - Gantz Graf[1] was a closer match as it has the dense production while still having some essence of a melody
